stem.text: The diagram shows a uniform bar of mass $M$ and length $L$ resting on a pivot at a distance $x$ from end X.

stem.alt: Horizontal bar with end labelled X on the left. A pivot is shown under the bar. Dimension arrows are labelled x (from end X to the pivot) and L (the full length of the bar).

stem.text: An object of mass $m$ is placed on the bar at distance $y$ from the pivot so that the bar is in equilibrium.
